name: close_build_computer
description: Tear a build computer down and discard its state. agentenv's teardown is tried first; if it leaves the computer up, REA removes that exact sandbox's containers, the one named agent-<sandbox id> and any labelled agentenv.sandbox=<sandbox id>, with REA_DOCKER_COMMAND. When neither confirms it, the error names what is left and the computer stays listed, so closing again retries. Closing cancels the call in progress on the computer and refuses those waiting for it.
